tasks.title: Scaffold app and verify Vercel preview
tasks.description: Build the complete Phase 0 setup in one branch and one PR so the empty app builds and deploys. Read docs/project.md §3, §4, §10, and §11, plus docs/plan.md Phase 0 and CLAUDE.md. Scaffold the pnpm monorepo with apps/web (Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind), apps/widget (vanilla TypeScript package shell), packages/shared and packages/db (package shells; no database schema or migration yet). Set up root scripts for pnpm dev, typecheck, lint, test, and build. Add a minimal home page, appropriate package and TypeScript config, .gitignore, and .env.example listing every variable in §11 with no values. Keep secrets out of the repo. Run all required checks. Open one PR; after the product owner connects the repository to Vercel with automatic promotion off, check the actual PR preview URL and load the home page there. Record the preview URL and checks in the PR. The product owner handles Vercel account/project settings and the protection bypass variable; coordinate through HQ and do not request or paste secret values.
tasks.doneWhen: pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint, pnpm test, and pnpm build all pass; the PR has a Vercel preview URL; the home page loads on that preview; the PR states checks and preview URL.
tasks.note: PR #1 is open and checks pass. Vercel is not connected yet: GitHub has no PR deployment/preview URL, and VERCEL_AUTOMATION_BYPASS_SECRET is not present. Product-owner action item aimwkgfow52 is pending.

Add pure-function/schema tests. Add the Phase 1 Clerk, Supabase, zod, and pglite dependencies to the relevant package manifests and lockfile up front so later tasks do not contend over manifests. Do not implement routes or database schema here. Explain any new dependencies in the PR.
tasks.doneWhen: Shared exports cover each §8 route and §5 plan limits; schema tests pass; pnpm typecheck, lint, test, and build pass; one PR is opened with the required preview/check notes.
tasks.note: All local checks pass. Vercel preview returned HTTP 200 and the homepage contains Askwell; preview URL and result added to PR #3.

tasks.title: Database schema and RLS
tasks.description: Lane A, owned by Tho ca. Read docs/project.md §7, §9 and CLAUDE.md. After P1F-T01 lands, add an additive SQL migration for all seven §7 tables, pgvector column/index, required constraints, RLS policies, grants, and narrowly scoped ownership helpers. Include the pglite test helper with Supabase role stubs and tests proving anon has no table/function access and owners cannot read another owner's rows. Keep packages/db/types.ts aligned with the migration in this PR. Never apply an unmerged migration to shared dev. Use the installed supabase and supabase-postgres-best-practices skills. After merge, apply this exact migration to dev through the Supabase MCP, regenerate types, and confirm no diff before closing the task.
tasks.doneWhen: Migration applies and tests pass on pglite; seven tables have RLS/grants and required constraints; cross-owner/anon access tests pass; pnpm checks pass; one PR is opened; after merge the migration is recorded on dev and regenerated types show no diff.
tasks.note: PR #5 opened; PGlite tests and all pnpm checks pass. Awaiting Vercel preview check and post-merge dev migration.

tasks.title: Projects list and create API
tasks.description: Lane A, owned by Tho ca. Read docs/project.md §5, §6.3, §7, §8, §9 and CLAUDE.md. Implement GET and POST /api/projects using the shared zod schemas and response types. Require a Clerk owner session; owner reads use createOwnerClient so RLS scopes projects. For create, read the account plan on the server, generate a random pk_ public key, and call create_project with PLAN_LIMITS.projects after checking ownership and account bootstrap. Map SQL limit errors to structured API errors; do not trust a client plan. Add route tests for empty/owned lists, Free and Pro creation limits, missing auth and errors. The merged P1F-T04 RPC contract is in PR #8; if the dev migration is still being applied, mock the RPC in tests and verify live behavior once available.
tasks.doneWhen: GET lists only the signed-in owner's projects; POST creates a project and default config; second Free project is refused and Pro allows five; unauthenticated requests fail; tests and all pnpm checks pass; preview loads; one PR is opened.

tasks.title: Widget loader
tasks.description: Lane B, owned by Tho phu. Read docs/project.md §6.5, §7, §8, §9, §11 and CLAUDE.md. Build the under-5-kb vanilla TypeScript loader in apps/widget. Read data-key from its own script tag, fetch GET /api/widget/config using the script origin, render a button in a shadow root, and open /embed?key=... in an iframe with the configured animation. Handle close, resize and unread postMessage events with strict event.origin checks and explicit target origins. Bad keys render nothing; keep secrets and host-page CSS out of the bundle. Arrange the build so /widget.js is served by apps/web and the public Install snippet can load it. The config route is P2P-T04 and may not be merged: use a mocked config response in loader tests until then. The /embed panel is P2P-T07: use an iframe fixture until it lands. Use the installed Next/React skills if touching web build configuration.
tasks.doneWhen: Loader bundle is under 5 kb, renders only for a valid mocked key, opens the iframe, respects host CSS isolation, and rejects wrong-origin postMessages; tests and all pnpm checks pass; preview serves /widget.js; one PR is opened.
tasks.note: PR #12 preview check is complete: /widget.js returns 200 from the Ready Vercel preview at 4,982 bytes. All pnpm checks pass. The Next dev-loop browser check remains blocked on Chromium package access requested via HQ.

tasks.title: Rename and delete project API
tasks.description: Lane A, owned by Tho ca. Read docs/project.md §6.3, §7, §8, §9 and CLAUDE.md. Implement PATCH and DELETE /api/projects/:id with shared schemas and error shape. Require a Clerk session. Rename through the owner client so RLS decides ownership and only name can be updated. Add route tests for authorized rename/delete, cross-owner isolation, missing project and signed-out requests. Use the merged P2P-T01 project mapping helper; if its branch is still in review, mock its response in tests and wait to merge this PR until the helper is on main.

tasks.title: Public widget config API
tasks.description: Lane A, owned by Tho ca. Read docs/project.md §5, §6.5, §7, §8, §9 and CLAUDE.md. Implement GET /api/widget/config for a pk_ public key, with shared input and response types. Resolve only the project and widget config needed by a visitor using the server-only service client; unknown key returns a structured NOT_FOUND. Read the owner's plan from the database on each request and apply DEFAULT_WIDGET_CONFIG plus the badge for Free, regardless of stored customization. Return CORS headers for any origin and handle OPTIONS. Never expose owner data or Supabase credentials. Add route tests for Free, Pro, missing key, invalid key and cross-origin requests. Arcjet key arrives in Phase 3; keep this route ready for that later rate-limit integration without inventing a paid service.
tasks.doneWhen: Valid public key returns only plan-applied config; bad key fails; Free cannot expose paid customization; CORS works across origins; tests and all pnpm checks pass; preview loads; one PR is opened.

tasks.title: Embed panel with mock replies

tasks.title: Structured owner API auth errors
tasks.description: Lane B, owned by Tho phu. Read docs/project.md §6.2, §8, §9 and CLAUDE.md. Add tests for signed-out owner API JSON, dashboard redirect, public paths and authenticated pass-through. Use PR #10's /api/projects preview behavior as a regression case; until #10 merges, mock an owner route in proxy tests.
